records.issue_text: src/sentry/spans/buffer.py:197: Changing existing span-buf:s: Redis keys from sets to sorted sets without migration or a new namespace causes WRONGTYPE errors for buffered data and makes old and new consumers incompatible during mixed-version deployments, breaking insertion and flushing.
records.rationale: The diff shows that in buffer.py line 197, the code changes from using Redis SET operations (sadd) to sorted set operations (zadd), and in line 434, from sscan to zscan. The key namespace 'span-buf:s:{project_and_trace}:{parent_span_id}' remains the same. During a rolling deployment, old workers would still use sadd/sscan expecting SET type, while new workers use zadd/zscan expecting ZSET type. Redis will return WRONGTYPE error when a command is used on a key of the wrong type. There is no migration logic, version detection, or transition handling visible in the diff. This is a real deployment
